blocks.text: Choco Mucho inches closer to a bronze medal finish after sweeping Nxled, 25-14, 25-23, 25-22, in the battle for third place of the 2026-27 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference Siklab series on Saturday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
